warm_memory.goal: Polish the Settings AI engine, permission tree, and policy authorization admin surfaces.
warm_memory.classification: coding.complex; frontend admin UI refactor plus backend permission catalog endpoint
constraints: Use taste-skill/design-taste guidance for frontend UI changes and keep the admin console restrained, dense, and dark-system aligned.
Treat AI engine provider/model setup separately from AI context facts used by demand deconstruction.
Permission growth should come from seeded backend permissions, not a fixed frontend matrix.
Do not touch or stage unrelated dirty files such as `well-ambient.db` or `internal/server/task_status.md`.
decisions: Split Settings AI into `AI 引擎配置` and `上下文事实` tabs via `AIConfig` view modes.
Restyled AI context fact editing with chip choice grids, custom range inputs, and dark-system registry/preview panels.
Added `GET /api/permissions` and a permission DTO so Settings can fetch the live catalog.
Replaced the wide permission matrix with a namespace-derived permission tree and per-group coverage toggles.
Rebuilt policy authorization creation as templates, segmented choices, action chips, state toggle, and priority stepper.
Added `Button.size` support because existing Settings/GitLab config call sites already use `size="small"`.
findings: The old `permissionMeta` table was the main scalability risk: new permissions would not appear until frontend code changed.
The policy form's native selects/number/checkbox made the page feel like raw schema editing rather than guided authorization.
The AI context registry had many unstyled classes and raw selects/ranges; splitting the tab and adding component-like controls clarifies intent.
Full Go tests need loopback access because existing GitLab webhook tests use `httptest.NewServer`; sandboxed runs fail on local port binding.
`pnpm check` still has pre-existing TaskKanban/App errors outside this change; production build passes.
validation: pnpm build in web: passed with existing Svelte accessibility warnings.
GOCACHE=/tmp/well-ambient-gocache go test ./internal/server and ./...: blocked by sandbox `listen tcp6 [::1]:0: bind: operation not permitted` from existing httptest server tests.
pnpm check in web: fails on pre-existing TaskKanban/App TypeScript errors; touched Settings/AI/Button files no longer add errors.
warm_memory.next: Stage and commit only intentional source/task-memory changes, excluding unrelated `well-ambient.db` and `internal/server/task_status.md`.
